I will never shop on AliExpress again.

I am sharing my experience so other customers are aware and can be cautious.

data.review_body:
I resisted ever buying anything on this online marketplace because I heard horror stories about their reputation but I finally took the plunge and boy did I end up regreting that decision. They allow scam advertisers to list items for sale that dont actually exist or are AI doctored pictures of popular products. Their customer service is horrendous, if you can even get them to respond during US business hours. I puchased an inverter from one of their 'trusted' sellers and the inverter shipped to me was broken. I tried to work with the Seller to fix the issues and they delayed and offered videos about other equipment or incorrectly labeled parts. That delay took me past the 15 day return period and even thought the Seller admitted they shipped me a faulty product they said they required Ali Express to approve my dispute. The dispute link on the AliExpress website did not work and when I got to them through a chatbot, they insisted on a process that had me submit evidence to an email address that did not accept reply messages and thus gave them what they needed to deny my dispute claim. Another purchase was cancelled after the seller collected my payment and then sat on my money for a month with no intention of ever shipping me the product I thought I was buying. These are simply not honorable people. Please avoid. 

Update after AliExpress response to my review. This company again shows it lack of honor by posting that they are still reviewing my dispute over faulty electrical equipment and non filled orders. In truth, they denied and closed my dispute within one day without any serious attempt to review the evidence, and they still advertise the fraudulent products/sellers on their webstore. Buyer beware!

data.review_body: I placed an order (8212466431475063) on July 8. On July 17th, it had yet to ship - and when I checked the details, the seller had moved the dispatch date forward - it was not scheduled to ship for 21 additional days. I cancelled the order and reordered the product from a reputable vendor. I woke up this morning to lies from the Ali seller - stating the order had been dispatched, but the tracking not uploaded, so they would do that now. The tracking clearly demonstrated that they dispatched *something* with a tracking number within hours of receiving my cancellation request. Having already ordered replacements from a reputable vendor (and knowing that this order will sit in an Ali sorting centre for a week) I have asked that this order be cancelled, in keeping with my request submitted well before dispatch. Instead, Ali support was very happy to tell me that my parcel was on the way, and that they understand the "anticipation" of waiting for an order. So perhaps there is a parcel on the way (full of things I no longer need) but more likely, I will have to wait out a 75 day clock to claim a refund when nothing arrives. I keep coming up against reasons to NEVER USE ALI AGAIN. One of these days, it will stick. But seriously - time and time again, the savings I realize by shopping here are clawed back by the fraud that is endemic on the site.

data.review_body:
DO NOT USE THE ALIEXPRESS APP OR ONLINE SHOP – ESPECIALLY THE WALLET!

This is based on my own experience.

I returned some items and was refunded, but I chose to keep the refund in my AliExpress Wallet to use for future purchases.

Later, I ordered more items using that wallet credit. One order arrived broken, so I returned it but my refund was £0. I let it go because it was only a few pounds and I didn’t want the hassle.

Then another order arrived with the wrong item. I contacted customer service, provided screenshots and all the evidence they requested, but after everything, the representative (“Aria”) still told me I would receive a £0 refund.

The £22.69 I had originally been refunded and stored in my AliExpress Wallet, my own money, was effectively gone because I had used wallet credit to pay for the order.

So from my experience, once you use AliExpress Wallet credit to buy something, returning that item may result in a £0 refund, even if the item is faulty or incorrect.

I won’t be shopping with AliExpress again, and I’d strongly advise others to be very careful about using the wallet feature.
